units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 70a:6">Snh. 70ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="G00179"><he>זוֹלֵל</he></cite>) <he>עד שיקח בשר בז׳ וכ׳</he> until he buys meat and wine at the lowest prices (in order to have large quantities).
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 73a">B. Mets. 73ᵃ</cite> <he>מקום הז׳</he> the place where prices are low.

<cite ref="Mishnah Maaser Sheni 4:2">Maas. Sh. IV, 2</cite> <he>בשער הז׳</he> at the lower (the wholesale) market price. Y. Keth. XII, beg. 34ᵃ <he>הין בז׳ וכ׳</he> if provision at the time was cheap and it rose.
<cite ref="Yoma 2a">Ib.</cite> <he>נותן בז׳</he> he pays alimentation according to the lower prices; a. fr.
